text:
## Template 9: Account Opened Confirmation  
**Trigger:** New account successfully created  
```
FirstUK: Welcome! Your SmartSaver account is open. Account:
[ACC-XXXXX]. Log in at www.firstuk.bank/login to activate.
Call 0800-555-2265 for help.
```  
*Character count: ~135*

raw_entities.description: SMS or push notification template sent to a customer immediately after successful creation of a new SmartSaver account. The message confirms account opening, provides the account number placeholder, directs the customer to log in via the online banking portal, and includes a customer service phone number for assistance.
